Name: Romanced Andy
Author: Sparkplus
Description:
This mod adds extensive romantic dialogue for Andy, and adjusts some of his events and schedules.

Additionally, I have created blushing portraits, Flower Dance sprites, and wedding sprites specifically for the Alternate Anthro Andy mod. These are included in the Alt Anthro Andy Patch file. If you wish, you can this patch in conjunction with the Alternate Anthro Andy mod.

Alt Anthro Andy Patch Installation:Simply overwrite the files of the Alternate Anthro Andy mod with the contents of this patch.

[b]Credits[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/kipsterland/]kipsterland[/url]: Custom sprites and portraits for Andy (Kissing, Flower Dance and Wedding sprites; and Blushing portraits).
